description_full:
Your responsibilities as designer intern will be as listed, but not limited to:

Editing company event videos (using Adobe illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe After Effect & VMIX)

Assist in online or hybrid events, such as operating Zoom apps

Assist handling videoshoot & photoshoot

Video Editing

Currently pursuing Bachelor’s Degree in Visual Communication Design or any related major

Creative and innovative mind to create fresh new ideas

Proficient skill using Adobe illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe After Effect & VMIX

Ability to work self-individually (initiative) and even as a part of a team

Ability to use professional camera

Fast learner and eager to grow
